title: VTG Garfield Uncle Ed Fireplace “Dear Diary Series” Collector's Plate Jim Davis
descriptionText:
Garfield "Uncle Ed" collector plate, "Dear Diary Series" by Jim Davis, The Danbury Mint, 1990. Plate No. B8332, an edition limited to 14 firing days. Porcelain, approx. 8" diameter.
Condition: excellent — no chips, cracks, or crazing noted. Not intended for food use (decorative display plate). Ships well-packed.
